purpose: Three frozen prompt sets, built locally through all five M0 stages, so the control and every candidate are generated from identical inputs.

held-out-10.role: Condition 4. The model has never heard these recordings, from any stage of the experiment.

seen-10.role: The memorisation control RUBRIC.md requires. Without it, a checkpoint that stored its 72 training sentences passes every other measurement M3 takes.

general-30.role: Conditions 3 and 5. The USER speaks and the model answers.

defect_this_step_closed.what: prepare_baseline_prompts could only build assistant-side prompts: audio on channel A, silence on B, and trailing padding only.
defect_this_step_closed.consequence: For the fixed conversations the user would have been silent through every frame generate.py returns. 'Does it ignore the user' and every turn-taking figure would have been measured against silence - the degenerate regime the past depformer-only run collapsed into, where nothing distinguishes health from failure.
defect_this_step_closed.fix: --channel B places the audio on the user stream and --lead-in-frames delays it into the window; user_voiced_frames_in_window counts what lands there.
defect_this_step_closed.evidence: All 30 prompts carry 37-80 user-voiced frames inside the window against a floor of 25, and channel A is silent in all 30. M0's prompts score 0 by construction.

limits: The user speaks once per conversation and the timeline has no overlap, so barge-in following can be probed but was never trained toward.
Speaker B is the same frozen voice as the training data's channel B, so the model hears a familiar partner. A different partner voice is not tested.
